At My Best Friend Veterinary Center, we believe better pet care starts with understanding. That’s why we created Corndog University—to make veterinary medicine easier to understand and help you feel confident caring for your best friend.

We’ll cover common illnesses, preventive care, medications, treatments, and practical ways to care for your pet at home. Our goal is to help you understand what’s happening, what you can do, what to watch for, and when it’s time to call your veterinarian.

Most importantly, we believe great veterinary care is built on trust. The closeness that makes your dog or cat part of your family should carry through to their veterinary care. We want your best friend to feel comfortable with us—and maybe even look forward to coming to see us.

Welcome to Corndog University. 🎓🐾
